Please raise this request in Discussions first; Rich asks that feature requests be approved there before an issue is opened. The [tables documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describes `Table.grid` as a layout tool for renderables, which may help with this arrangement.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
